# Aster Series Product Catalog

The Aster 8 and Aster 12 air-to-water heat-pump systems are manufactured for Atlas Heatworks by Norrby Climate Systems. Product specifications are governed by the current Customer Support and Warranty Policy for service and warranty handling.
